task.title: Complete tasks through passed Verification gates
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/775 with an explicit caller-selected completion boundary that cannot authorize from stale green evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Complete with exact output only when every caller-required gate passes for one exact Attempt.
Return typed ordered Pending or Failed reports and typed invalid-Attempt causes without writes.
Re-evaluate after concurrent task stream changes so a newer failed Verification blocks stale completion.
Preserve authoritative terminal races, historical replay, and the existing unconditional completion primitive.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused verified-completion test failed because the guarded API and typed completion error did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added all-passed persistence, ordered rejection, invalid-Attempt, terminal-state, historical compatibility, and deterministic stale-evidence race tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Separately evaluating gates before unconditional completion left a time-of-check/time-of-use gap on the task stream.
attempts.patch: Added a store-owned loop that evaluates the exact projected version, appends the existing completion event at that version, and reloads plus re-evaluates after concurrent writes; documented the caller-owned policy boundary in ADR-0031.

attempts.summary: Closed terminal-race coverage and a redundant clone after substantive review.
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that terminal authority was covered only sequentially inside the new evaluation-to-append window and that the success path cloned output after its final use.
attempts.patch: Added a deterministic concurrent cancellation test, moved output on successful append, reran the full gate, and withheld auto-merge until the exact follow-up head received a genuine review after rate limiting.

outcome.summary: Caller-selected gates can authorize durable task completion without stale green races, while typed rejections, terminal authority, exact output replay, and unconditional caller-owned completion remain intact.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_verified_completion

lessons: Authorization and the state mutation it guards must share an exact-version boundary to prevent stale green decisions.
Concurrent terminal transitions remain authoritative even when gate evidence was valid immediately beforehand.
Move owned completion output only after a successful append so retries retain it without paying for a redundant success-path clone.
A green review status carrying a rate-limit warning is not substantive exact-head review evidence.
Keep unconditional lifecycle primitives when policy remains an explicit caller-owned choice rather than global persisted authority.
